"""Add a cover page with title and current date to report.pdf."""
import os
import sys
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover_page.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE_STR = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF):
        print(f"ERROR: {INPUT_PDF} not found in workspace")
        sys.exit(1)

    # Verify the input is a readable PDF and count its pages
    try:
        reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
        num_pages = len(reader.pages)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"ERROR: could not read {INPUT_PDF}: {exc}")
        sys.exit(1)

    # Create a one-page cover PDF (US Letter) with title and current date
    width, height = letter
    c = canvas.Canvas(COVER_PDF, pagesize=letter)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 30, TITLE)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 20, DATE_STR)
    c.save()

    # Merge cover page ahead of the original report pages
    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as out:
        writer.write(out)

    print(f"SUCCESS: wrote {OUTPUT_PDF}")
    print(f"  Total pages: {len(writer.pages)} (1 cover + {num_pages} original)")
    print(f"  Cover title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"  Cover date:  {DATE_STR}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Dump the object structure of a classic (PDF 1.3) PDF file for inspection."""
import re
import sys

PATH = "report.pdf"


def parse_xref_and_trailer(data):
    # Find last startxref
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data))
    if not matches:
        raise ValueError("no startxref found")
    startxref = int(matches[-1].group(1))
    print(f"startxref offset: {startxref}")

    # Read xref section(s) starting at startxref
    pos = startxref
    entries = {}
    trailer = {}
    for _ in range(10):
        # expect "xref" keyword
        m = re.match(rb"\s*xref\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[pos:])
        if not m:
            raise ValueError(f"no xref keyword at {pos}: {data[pos:pos+40]!r}")
        first = int(m.group(1))
        count = int(m.group(2))
        pos += m.end()
        for i in range(count):
            line = data[pos:pos + 20]
            if len(line) < 20:
                raise ValueError("short xref line")
            off = int(line[0:10])
            gen = int(line[11:16])
            kind = line[17:18]
            entries[first + i] = (off, gen, kind)
            pos += 20
        # optional subsection of same xref section
        nxt = re.match(rb"\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[pos:])
        if nxt:
            continue
        # trailer
        tm = re.match(rb"\s*trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", data[pos:], re.S)
        if not tm:
            raise ValueError(f"no trailer at {pos}: {data[pos:pos+80]!r}")
        trailer_raw = tm.group(1)
        trailer = dict(re.findall(rb"/(\w+)\s+([^\s/]+)", trailer_raw))
        pos += tm.end()
        # chain to previous xref via /Prev if present
        if b"/Prev" in trailer_raw:
            prev = int(re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer_raw).group(1))
            print(f"prev xref at {prev}")
            pos = prev
            continue
        break
    return entries, trailer


def read_object(data, offset):
    """Read one indirect object starting at offset. Returns (num, gen, body_bytes)."""
    m = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj\s*", data[offset:])
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"bad obj start at {offset}: {data[offset:offset+40]!r}")
    num = int(m.group(1))
    gen = int(m.group(2))
    pos = offset + m.end()
    # find matching 'endobj'
    end = data.find(b"endobj", pos)
    if end == -1:
        raise ValueError("no endobj")
    body = data[pos:end]
    return num, gen, body


def main():
    with open(PATH, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    print(f"file size: {len(data)} bytes")

    entries, trailer = parse_xref_and_trailer(data)
    print(f"xref entries: {len(entries)}")
    print(f"trailer: {trailer}")
    print(f"Root: {trailer.get(b'Root')}, Info: {trailer.get(b'Info')}, Size: {trailer.get(b'Size')}")

    for num in sorted(entries):
        off, gen, kind = entries[num]
        if kind == b"f":
            continue
        try:
            onum, ogen, body = read_object(data, off)
            has_stream = b"stream" in body[:40] or body.rstrip().endswith(b"stream")
            preview = body[:300].replace(b"\n", b"\\n").replace(b"\r", b"\\r")
            print(f"\n--- object {onum} {ogen} (offset {off}, stream={has_stream}) ---")
            print(preview.decode("latin-1"))
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"\n--- object {num} parse error: {exc} ---")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

PATH = "report.pdf"

    print(f"startxref offset: {startxref}")

    pos = startxref
    entries = {}
    trailer = {}

        if nxt and data[pos:pos + 20].count(b"\n") >= 2:
            # another subsection header (numbers followed by xref lines)
            nxt2 = re.match(rb"\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*\n", data[pos:])
            if nxt2:

        tm = re.match(rb"\s*trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", data[pos:], re.S)
        if not tm:

        trailer = dict(re.findall(rb"/(\w+)\s+([^\s/]+)", trailer_raw))
        pos += tm.end()
        if b"/Prev" in trailer_raw:
            prev = int(re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer_raw).group(1))
            print(f"prev xref at {prev}")
            pos = prev
            continue
        break
    return entries, trailer


def read_object(data, offset):

    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"bad obj start at {offset}: {data[offset:offset+40]!r}")
    num = int(m.group(1))
    gen = int(m.group(2))
    pos = offset + m.end()
    end = data.find(b"endobj", pos)
    if end == -1:
        raise ValueError("no endobj")
    body = data[pos:end]
    return num, gen, body


def main():
    with open(PATH, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    print(f"file size: {len(data)} bytes")

    entries, trailer = parse_xref_and_trailer(data)
    print(f"xref entries: {sorted(entries)}")
    print(f"trailer: {trailer}")
    print(f"Root: {trailer.get(b'Root')}, Info: {trailer.get(b'Info')}, Size: {trailer.get(b'Size')}")

    for num in sorted(entries):
        off, gen, kind = entries[num]
        if kind == b"f":
            continue
        onum, ogen, body = read_object(data, off)
        has_stream = b"stream" in body[:60] and b"endstream" in body
        print(f"\n--- object {onum} {ogen} (offset {off}, stream={has_stream}) ---")
        print(body[:400].decode("latin-1"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using pure Python.

Works on classic PDF 1.x files with a plain xref table (no object streams).
Strategy:
  1. Parse report.pdf: trailer, xref, and verbatim object bodies.
  2. Build new objects for the cover (content stream, page, Pages root, Catalog, Info)
     using the standard-14 Helvetica-Bold font (object 3, reused).
  3. Emit a new PDF: header, new objects, original objects copied verbatim,
     fresh xref table, trailer.
  4. Validate the merged bytes by re-parsing before overwriting report.pdf.
"""

import re
import sys
from datetime import date

INPUT = "report.pdf"

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

# Helvetica-Bold glyph widths (per 1000 units), standard Adobe AFM values.
W = {
    ' ': 278, '!': 333, '"': 474, '#': 556, '$': 556, '%': 889, '&': 722,
    "'": 238, '(': 333, ')': 333, '*': 389, '+': 584, ',': 278, '-': 333,
    '.': 278, '/': 556,
    '0': 556, '1': 556, '2': 556, '3': 556, '4': 556, '5': 556, '6': 556,
    '7': 556, '8': 556, '9': 556,
    ':': 333, ';': 333, '<': 584, '=': 584, '>': 584, '?': 611, '@': 975,
    'A': 722, 'B': 722, 'C': 722, 'D': 722, 'E': 667, 'F': 667, 'G': 778,
    'H': 722, 'I': 278, 'J': 556, 'K': 722, 'L': 611, 'M': 833, 'N': 722,
    'O': 778, 'P': 667, 'Q': 778, 'R': 722, 'S': 667, 'T': 611, 'U': 722,
    'V': 667, 'W': 944, 'X': 667, 'Y': 667, 'Z': 611,
    '[': 333, '\\': 556, ']': 333, '^': 584, '_': 556, '`': 333,
    'a': 667, 'b': 667, 'c': 556, 'd': 667, 'e': 556, 'f': 500, 'g': 667,
    'h': 722, 'i': 278, 'j': 500, 'k': 667, 'l': 278, 'm': 833, 'n': 722,
    'o': 722, 'p': 667, 'q': 722, 'r': 556, 's': 556, 't': 333, 'u': 722,
    'v': 667, 'w': 944, 'x': 667, 'y': 667, 'z': 611,
    '{': 389, '|': 280, '}': 389, '~': 584,
}

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter

XREF_LINE = re.compile(rb"\s*(\d{10})\s+(\d{5})\s+([nf])")


def text_width(s, size):
    return sum(W.get(ch, 556) for ch in s) / 1000.0 * size


def parse_pdf(data):
    """Return (entries, trailer, objects) for a classic-xref PDF."""
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data))
    if not matches:
        raise ValueError("no startxref found")
    startxref = int(matches[-1].group(1))

    pos = startxref
    entries = {}
    trailer_raw = b""
    for _ in range(10):
        m = re.match(rb"\s*xref\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[pos:])
        if not m:
            raise ValueError(f"no xref keyword at {pos}")
        first, count = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        pos += m.end()
        for i in range(count):
            lm = XREF_LINE.match(data, pos)
            if not lm:
                raise ValueError(f"bad xref line at {pos}")
            entries[first + i] = (int(lm.group(1)), int(lm.group(2)), lm.group(3))
            pos = lm.end()
        # possible additional subsection of the same xref section
        while re.match(rb"\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*\n", data[pos:pos + 40]):
            m2 = re.match(rb"\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*\n", data[pos:])
            first, count = int(m2.group(1)), int(m2.group(2))
            pos += m2.end()
            for i in range(count):
                lm = XREF_LINE.match(data, pos)
                if not lm:
                    raise ValueError(f"bad xref line at {pos}")
                entries[first + i] = (int(lm.group(1)), int(lm.group(2)), lm.group(3))
                pos = lm.end()
        tm = re.match(rb"\s*trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", data[pos:], re.S)
        if not tm:
            raise ValueError(f"no trailer at {pos}")
        trailer_raw = tm.group(1)
        pos += tm.end()
        if b"/Prev" in trailer_raw:
            prev = int(re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer_raw).group(1))
            pos = prev
            continue
        break

    objects = {}
    for num, (off, gen, kind) in entries.items():
        if kind == b"f":
            continue
        om = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj\s*", data[off:])
        if not om:
            raise ValueError(f"object {num}: bad start at {off}")
        body_start = off + om.end()
        end = data.find(b"endobj", body_start)
        if end == -1:
            raise ValueError(f"object {num}: no endobj")
        objects[num] = (int(om.group(2)), data[body_start:end])
    return entries, trailer_raw, objects


def parse_simple_dict(body):
    """Extract /Key value tokens (raw) from a dictionary body."""
    return dict(re.findall(rb"/(\w+)\s+([^\s/]+)", body))


def build_cover_stream(title, date_str):
    """Return bytes for the cover content stream (uncompressed, PDF 1.3 OK)."""
    title_w = text_width(title, 30)
    date_w = text_width(date_str, 16)
    x_title = (PAGE_W - title_w) / 2
    x_date = (PAGE_W - date_w) / 2
    lines = [
        "BT",
        "/F1 30 Tf",
        "0 0 0 rg",
        f"{x_title:.2f} 500 Td",
        f"({title}) Tj",
        "/F1 16 Tf",
        f"{x_date:.2f} 462 Tm",
        f"({date_str}) Tj",
        "ET",
    ]
    return ("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode("latin-1")


def main():
    with open(INPUT, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    entries, trailer_raw, objects = parse_pdf(data)
    orig_size = max(entries) + 1
    print(f"parsed report.pdf: {len(objects)} objects, Size={orig_size}, "
          f"Root={parse_simple_dict(trailer_raw).get(b'Root')}")

    date_str = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"current date used on cover: {date_str}")

    # --- build new objects (numbers 9-13; originals are 1-8) ---
    stream_bytes = build_cover_stream(TITLE, date_str)

    obj9 = (b"<< /Length " + str(len(stream_bytes)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n"
            + stream_bytes + b"\nendstream")
    obj10 = (b"<<\n/Contents 9 0 R\n/MediaBox [ 0 0 " + str(PAGE_W).encode() + b" "
             + str(PAGE_H).encode() + b" ]\n/Parent 11 0 R\n/Resources <<\n"
             b"/Font << /F1 3 0 R >>\n/ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ]\n>>\n"
             b"/Rotate 0\n/Type /Page\n>>")
    obj11 = b"<<\n/Count 2\n/Kids [ 10 0 R 7 0 R ]\n/Type /Pages\n>>"
    obj12 = b"<<\n/PageMode /UseNone\n/Pages 11 0 R\n/Type /Catalog\n>>"
    now = date.today()
    pdf_date = f"D:{now.year:04d}{now.month:02d}{now.day:02d}000000"
    obj13 = (b"<<\n/Title (" + TITLE.encode("latin-1") + b")\n/CreationDate ("
             + pdf_date.encode() + b")\n/ModDate (" + pdf_date.encode()
             + b")\n/Producer (ReportLab PDF Library - (opensource))\n>>")

    # --- assemble the merged file ---
    chunks = [b"%PDF-1.3\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"]
    pos = len(chunks[0])
    offsets = {}

    def add_object(num, gen, body):
        nonlocal pos
        offsets[num] = pos
        chunk = f"{num} {gen} obj\n".encode("latin-1") + body + b"\nendobj\n"
        chunks.append(chunk)
        pos += len(chunk)

    for num, body in [(9, obj9), (10, obj10), (11, obj11), (12, obj12), (13, obj13)]:
        add_object(num, 0, body)
    for num in sorted(objects):  # original objects copied verbatim
        gen, body = objects[num]
        add_object(num, gen, body)

    new_size = max(offsets) + 1  # 14
    xref_pos = pos
    xref = b"xref\n0 " + str(new_size).encode() + b"\n"
    xref += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, new_size):
        xref += f"{offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    chunks.append(xref)
    pos += len(xref)

    id_m = re.search(rb"/ID\s*\[([^\]]+)\]", trailer_raw)
    id_line = b"/ID [" + id_m.group(1) + b"]\n" if id_m else b""
    trailer = (b"trailer\n<<\n" + id_line
               + b"/Info 13 0 R\n/Root 12 0 R\n/Size " + str(new_size).encode()
               + b"\n>>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos).encode() + b"\n%%EOF\n")
    chunks.append(trailer)

    merged = b"".join(chunks)
    print(f"merged PDF size: {len(merged)} bytes, {new_size - 1} used objects")

    # --- validate by re-parsing the merged bytes ---
    check_merged(merged, date_str)
    print("validation passed: merged PDF parses cleanly")

    with open(INPUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(merged)
    print(f"wrote cover page + report to {INPUT} (1 cover + 1 original page)")


def check_merged(merged, date_str):
    entries, trailer_raw, objects = parse_pdf(merged)
    assert 13 in objects and 12 in objects and 11 in objects
    assert 10 in objects and 9 in objects and 7 in objects and 4 in objects
    tr = parse_simple_dict(trailer_raw)
    assert tr[b"Root"] == b"12" and tr[b"Info"] == b"13" and tr[b"Size"] == b"14", tr

    cat = parse_simple_dict(objects[12][1])
    assert cat[b"Pages"] == b"11" and cat[b"Type"] == b"/Catalog", cat
    pages = parse_simple_dict(objects[11][1])
    assert pages[b"Count"] == b"2" and pages[b"Type"] == b"/Pages", pages
    assert b"[ 10 0 R 7 0 R ]" in objects[11][1]

    cover = parse_simple_dict(objects[10][1])
    assert cover[b"Parent"] == b"11" and cover[b"Contents"] == b"9", cover
    assert cover[b"Type"] == b"/Page"
    assert b"/MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ]" in objects[10][1]

    stream_body = objects[9][1]
    assert b"stream\n" in stream_body and b"endstream" in stream_body
    assert TITLE.encode() in stream_body
    assert date_str.encode() in stream_body

    old_page = parse_simple_dict(objects[4][1])
    assert old_page[b"Parent"] == b"7", old_page

    # every in-use object referenced by the trailer/root chain resolves
    for num in range(1, 14):
        assert num in entries, num
    print(f"  cover title '{TITLE}' and date '{date_str}' present in stream object 9")
    print(f"  pages tree: Count=2, Kids=[10 0 R (cover), 7 0 R (original pages)]")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"FAILED: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

"""Add a cover page with title and current date to report.pdf."""
import os
import sys
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover_page.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE_STR = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF):
        print(f"ERROR: {INPUT_PDF} not found in workspace")
        sys.exit(1)

    # Verify the input is a readable PDF and count its pages
    try:
        reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
        num_pages = len(reader.pages)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"ERROR: could not read {INPUT_PDF}: {exc}")
        sys.exit(1)

    # Create a one-page cover PDF (US Letter) with title and current date
    width, height = letter
    c = canvas.Canvas(COVER_PDF, pagesize=letter)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 30, TITLE)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 20, DATE_STR)
    c.save()

    # Merge cover page ahead of the original report pages
    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as out:
        writer.write(out)

    print(f"SUCCESS: wrote {OUTPUT_PDF}")
    print(f"  Total pages: {len(writer.pages)} (1 cover + {num_pages} original)")
    print(f"  Cover title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"  Cover date:  {DATE_STR}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Dump the object structure of a classic (PDF 1.3) PDF file for inspection."""
import re
import sys

PATH = "report.pdf"


def parse_xref_and_trailer(data):
    # Find last startxref
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data))
    if not matches:
        raise ValueError("no startxref found")
    startxref = int(matches[-1].group(1))
    print(f"startxref offset: {startxref}")

    # Read xref section(s) starting at startxref
    pos = startxref
    entries = {}
    trailer = {}
    for _ in range(10):
        # expect "xref" keyword
        m = re.match(rb"\s*xref\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[pos:])
        if not m:
            raise ValueError(f"no xref keyword at {pos}: {data[pos:pos+40]!r}")
        first = int(m.group(1))
        count = int(m.group(2))
        pos += m.end()
        for i in range(count):
            line = data[pos:pos + 20]
            if len(line) < 20:
                raise ValueError("short xref line")
            off = int(line[0:10])
            gen = int(line[11:16])
            kind = line[17:18]
            entries[first + i] = (off, gen, kind)
            pos += 20
        # optional subsection of same xref section
        nxt = re.match(rb"\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[pos:])
        if nxt:
            continue
        # trailer
        tm = re.match(rb"\s*trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", data[pos:], re.S)
        if not tm:
            raise ValueError(f"no trailer at {pos}: {data[pos:pos+80]!r}")
        trailer_raw = tm.group(1)
        trailer = dict(re.findall(rb"/(\w+)\s+([^\s/]+)", trailer_raw))
        pos += tm.end()
        # chain to previous xref via /Prev if present
        if b"/Prev" in trailer_raw:
            prev = int(re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer_raw).group(1))
            print(f"prev xref at {prev}")
            pos = prev
            continue
        break
    return entries, trailer


def read_object(data, offset):
    """Read one indirect object starting at offset. Returns (num, gen, body_bytes)."""
    m = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj\s*", data[offset:])
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"bad obj start at {offset}: {data[offset:offset+40]!r}")
    num = int(m.group(1))
    gen = int(m.group(2))
    pos = offset + m.end()
    # find matching 'endobj'
    end = data.find(b"endobj", pos)
    if end == -1:
        raise ValueError("no endobj")
    body = data[pos:end]
    return num, gen, body


def main():
    with open(PATH, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    print(f"file size: {len(data)} bytes")

    entries, trailer = parse_xref_and_trailer(data)
    print(f"xref entries: {len(entries)}")
    print(f"trailer: {trailer}")
    print(f"Root: {trailer.get(b'Root')}, Info: {trailer.get(b'Info')}, Size: {trailer.get(b'Size')}")

    for num in sorted(entries):
        off, gen, kind = entries[num]
        if kind == b"f":
            continue
        try:
            onum, ogen, body = read_object(data, off)
            has_stream = b"stream" in body[:40] or body.rstrip().endswith(b"stream")
            preview = body[:300].replace(b"\n", b"\\n").replace(b"\r", b"\\r")
            print(f"\n--- object {onum} {ogen} (offset {off}, stream={has_stream}) ---")
            print(preview.decode("latin-1"))
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"\n--- object {num} parse error: {exc} ---")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

PATH = "report.pdf"

def parse_xref_and_trailer(data):

    print(f"startxref offset: {startxref}")

    entries = {}
    trailer = {}

        count = int(m.group(2))

            gen = int(lm.group(2))

        nxt = re.match(rb"\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*$", data[pos:pos + 40])
        if nxt and data[pos:pos + 20].count(b"\n") >= 2:
            # another subsection header (numbers followed by xref lines)
            nxt2 = re.match(rb"\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*\n", data[pos:])
            if nxt2:

        tm = re.match(rb"\s*trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", data[pos:], re.S)
        if not tm:
            raise ValueError(f"no trailer at {pos}: {data[pos:pos+80]!r}")

        trailer = dict(re.findall(rb"/(\w+)\s+([^\s/]+)", trailer_raw))
        pos += tm.end()
        if b"/Prev" in trailer_raw:
            prev = int(re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer_raw).group(1))
            print(f"prev xref at {prev}")
            pos = prev
            continue
        break
    return entries, trailer


def read_object(data, offset):

    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"bad obj start at {offset}: {data[offset:offset+40]!r}")
    num = int(m.group(1))

    end = data.find(b"endobj", pos)
    if end == -1:
        raise ValueError("no endobj")
    body = data[pos:end]
    return num, gen, body


def main():
    with open(PATH, "rb") as f:

    print(f"file size: {len(data)} bytes")

    entries, trailer = parse_xref_and_trailer(data)
    print(f"xref entries: {sorted(entries)}")
    print(f"trailer: {trailer}")
    print(f"Root: {trailer.get(b'Root')}, Info: {trailer.get(b'Info')}, Size: {trailer.get(b'Size')}")

    for num in sorted(entries):
        off, gen, kind = entries[num]
        if kind == b"f":
            continue
        onum, ogen, body = read_object(data, off)
        has_stream = b"stream" in body[:60] and b"endstream" in body
        print(f"\n--- object {onum} {ogen} (offset {off}, stream={has_stream}) ---")
        print(body[:400].decode("latin-1"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using pure Python.

Works on classic PDF 1.x files with a plain xref table (no object streams).
Strategy:
  1. Parse report.pdf: trailer, xref, and verbatim object bodies.
  2. Build new objects for the cover (content stream, page, Pages root, Catalog, Info)
     using the standard-14 Helvetica-Bold font (object 3, reused).
  3. Emit a new PDF: header, new objects, original objects copied verbatim,
     fresh xref table, trailer.
  4. Validate the merged bytes by re-parsing before overwriting report.pdf.
"""

import re
import sys
from datetime import date

INPUT = "report.pdf"

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

# Helvetica-Bold glyph widths (per 1000 units), standard Adobe AFM values.
W = {
    ' ': 278, '!': 333, '"': 474, '#': 556, '$': 556, '%': 889, '&': 722,
    "'": 238, '(': 333, ')': 333, '*': 389, '+': 584, ',': 278, '-': 333,
    '.': 278, '/': 556,
    '0': 556, '1': 556, '2': 556, '3': 556, '4': 556, '5': 556, '6': 556,
    '7': 556, '8': 556, '9': 556,
    ':': 333, ';': 333, '<': 584, '=': 584, '>': 584, '?': 611, '@': 975,
    'A': 722, 'B': 722, 'C': 722, 'D': 722, 'E': 667, 'F': 667, 'G': 778,
    'H': 722, 'I': 278, 'J': 556, 'K': 722, 'L': 611, 'M': 833, 'N': 722,
    'O': 778, 'P': 667, 'Q': 778, 'R': 722, 'S': 667, 'T': 611, 'U': 722,
    'V': 667, 'W': 944, 'X': 667, 'Y': 667, 'Z': 611,
    '[': 333, '\\': 556, ']': 333, '^': 584, '_': 556, '`': 333,
    'a': 667, 'b': 667, 'c': 556, 'd': 667, 'e': 556, 'f': 500, 'g': 667,
    'h': 722, 'i': 278, 'j': 500, 'k': 667, 'l': 278, 'm': 833, 'n': 722,
    'o': 722, 'p': 667, 'q': 722, 'r': 556, 's': 556, 't': 333, 'u': 722,
    'v': 667, 'w': 944, 'x': 667, 'y': 667, 'z': 611,
    '{': 389, '|': 280, '}': 389, '~': 584,
}

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter

XREF_LINE = re.compile(rb"\s*(\d{10})\s+(\d{5})\s+([nf])")


def text_width(s, size):
    return sum(W.get(ch, 556) for ch in s) / 1000.0 * size


def parse_pdf(data):
    """Return (entries, trailer, objects) for a classic-xref PDF."""
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data))
    if not matches:
        raise ValueError("no startxref found")
    startxref = int(matches[-1].group(1))

    pos = startxref
    entries = {}
    trailer_raw = b""
    for _ in range(10):
        m = re.match(rb"\s*xref\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[pos:])
        if not m:
            raise ValueError(f"no xref keyword at {pos}")
        first, count = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        pos += m.end()
        for i in range(count):
            lm = XREF_LINE.match(data, pos)
            if not lm:
                raise ValueError(f"bad xref line at {pos}")
            entries[first + i] = (int(lm.group(1)), int(lm.group(2)), lm.group(3))
            pos = lm.end()
        # possible additional subsection of the same xref section
        while re.match(rb"\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*\n", data[pos:pos + 40]):
            m2 = re.match(rb"\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*\n", data[pos:])
            first, count = int(m2.group(1)), int(m2.group(2))
            pos += m2.end()
            for i in range(count):
                lm = XREF_LINE.match(data, pos)
                if not lm:
                    raise ValueError(f"bad xref line at {pos}")
                entries[first + i] = (int(lm.group(1)), int(lm.group(2)), lm.group(3))
                pos = lm.end()
        tm = re.match(rb"\s*trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", data[pos:], re.S)
        if not tm:
            raise ValueError(f"no trailer at {pos}")
        trailer_raw = tm.group(1)
        pos += tm.end()
        if b"/Prev" in trailer_raw:
            prev = int(re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer_raw).group(1))
            pos = prev
            continue
        break

    objects = {}
    for num, (off, gen, kind) in entries.items():
        if kind == b"f":
            continue
        om = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj\s*", data[off:])
        if not om:
            raise ValueError(f"object {num}: bad start at {off}")
        body_start = off + om.end()
        end = data.find(b"endobj", body_start)
        if end == -1:
            raise ValueError(f"object {num}: no endobj")
        objects[num] = (int(om.group(2)), data[body_start:end])
    return entries, trailer_raw, objects


def parse_simple_dict(body):
    """Extract /Key value tokens (raw) from a dictionary body."""
    return dict(re.findall(rb"/(\w+)\s+([^\s/]+)", body))


def build_cover_stream(title, date_str):
    """Return bytes for the cover content stream (uncompressed, PDF 1.3 OK)."""
    title_w = text_width(title, 30)
    date_w = text_width(date_str, 16)
    x_title = (PAGE_W - title_w) / 2
    x_date = (PAGE_W - date_w) / 2
    lines = [
        "BT",
        "/F1 30 Tf",
        "0 0 0 rg",
        f"{x_title:.2f} 500 Td",
        f"({title}) Tj",
        "/F1 16 Tf",
        f"{x_date:.2f} 462 Tm",
        f"({date_str}) Tj",
        "ET",
    ]
    return ("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode("latin-1")


def main():
    with open(INPUT, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    entries, trailer_raw, objects = parse_pdf(data)
    orig_size = max(entries) + 1
    print(f"parsed report.pdf: {len(objects)} objects, Size={orig_size}, "
          f"Root={parse_simple_dict(trailer_raw).get(b'Root')}")

    date_str = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"current date used on cover: {date_str}")

    # --- build new objects (numbers 9-13; originals are 1-8) ---
    stream_bytes = build_cover_stream(TITLE, date_str)

    obj9 = (b"<< /Length " + str(len(stream_bytes)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n"
            + stream_bytes + b"\nendstream")
    obj10 = (b"<<\n/Contents 9 0 R\n/MediaBox [ 0 0 " + str(PAGE_W).encode() + b" "
             + str(PAGE_H).encode() + b" ]\n/Parent 11 0 R\n/Resources <<\n"
             b"/Font << /F1 3 0 R >>\n/ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ]\n>>\n"
             b"/Rotate 0\n/Type /Page\n>>")
    obj11 = b"<<\n/Count 2\n/Kids [ 10 0 R 7 0 R ]\n/Type /Pages\n>>"
    obj12 = b"<<\n/PageMode /UseNone\n/Pages 11 0 R\n/Type /Catalog\n>>"
    now = date.today()
    pdf_date = f"D:{now.year:04d}{now.month:02d}{now.day:02d}000000"
    obj13 = (b"<<\n/Title (" + TITLE.encode("latin-1") + b")\n/CreationDate ("
             + pdf_date.encode() + b")\n/ModDate (" + pdf_date.encode()
             + b")\n/Producer (ReportLab PDF Library - (opensource))\n>>")

    # --- assemble the merged file ---
    chunks = [b"%PDF-1.3\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"]
    pos = len(chunks[0])
    offsets = {}

    def add_object(num, gen, body):
        nonlocal pos
        offsets[num] = pos
        chunk = f"{num} {gen} obj\n".encode("latin-1") + body + b"\nendobj\n"
        chunks.append(chunk)
        pos += len(chunk)

    for num, body in [(9, obj9), (10, obj10), (11, obj11), (12, obj12), (13, obj13)]:
        add_object(num, 0, body)
    for num in sorted(objects):  # original objects copied verbatim
        gen, body = objects[num]
        add_object(num, gen, body)

    new_size = max(offsets) + 1  # 14
    xref_pos = pos
    xref = b"xref\n0 " + str(new_size).encode() + b"\n"
    xref += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, new_size):
        xref += f"{offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    chunks.append(xref)
    pos += len(xref)

    id_m = re.search(rb"/ID\s*\[([^\]]+)\]", trailer_raw)
    id_line = b"/ID [" + id_m.group(1) + b"]\n" if id_m else b""
    trailer = (b"trailer\n<<\n" + id_line
               + b"/Info 13 0 R\n/Root 12 0 R\n/Size " + str(new_size).encode()
               + b"\n>>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos).encode() + b"\n%%EOF\n")
    chunks.append(trailer)

    merged = b"".join(chunks)
    print(f"merged PDF size: {len(merged)} bytes, {new_size - 1} used objects")

    # --- validate by re-parsing the merged bytes ---
    check_merged(merged, date_str)
    print("validation passed: merged PDF parses cleanly")

    with open(INPUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(merged)
    print(f"wrote cover page + report to {INPUT} (1 cover + 1 original page)")


def check_merged(merged, date_str):
    entries, trailer_raw, objects = parse_pdf(merged)
    assert 13 in objects and 12 in objects and 11 in objects
    assert 10 in objects and 9 in objects and 7 in objects and 4 in objects
    tr = parse_simple_dict(trailer_raw)
    assert tr[b"Root"] == b"12" and tr[b"Info"] == b"13" and tr[b"Size"] == b"14", tr

    cat = parse_simple_dict(objects[12][1])
    assert cat[b"Pages"] == b"11" and cat[b"Type"] == b"/Catalog", cat
    pages = parse_simple_dict(objects[11][1])
    assert pages[b"Count"] == b"2" and pages[b"Type"] == b"/Pages", pages
    assert b"[ 10 0 R 7 0 R ]" in objects[11][1]

    cover = parse_simple_dict(objects[10][1])
    assert cover[b"Parent"] == b"11" and cover[b"Contents"] == b"9", cover
    assert cover[b"Type"] == b"/Page"
    assert b"/MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ]" in objects[10][1]

    stream_body = objects[9][1]
    assert b"stream\n" in stream_body and b"endstream" in stream_body
    assert TITLE.encode() in stream_body
    assert date_str.encode() in stream_body

    old_page = parse_simple_dict(objects[4][1])
    assert old_page[b"Parent"] == b"7", old_page

    # every in-use object referenced by the trailer/root chain resolves
    for num in range(1, 14):
        assert num in entries, num
    print(f"  cover title '{TITLE}' and date '{date_str}' present in stream object 9")
    print(f"  pages tree: Count=2, Kids=[10 0 R (cover), 7 0 R (original pages)]")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"FAILED: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
